Structural Rebar · Revit Add-in

Isolated Footing Rebar

Detail isolated footings. Repeat the setup across matching types.

Set up top and bottom meshes, side bars, and concrete cover in Revit. Apply the same reinforcement settings to a representative footing or to every matching instance.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Watch Demo
Key features

Keep footing details consistent across the model

A small change in spacing or cover can mean revisiting dozens of footings. Set the reinforcement rules by type, then check the generated bars against your detailing requirements.

  • 01

    Bottom mesh & top mesh generation with full diameter and spacing control

  • 02

    Side bar placement

    single or multiple bars based on footing depth

  • 03

    Uniform bar distribution respecting concrete cover on all sides

  • 04

    Apply lateral cover constraints to generated bars.

  • 05

    Flexible selection

    pick elements directly in the Revit model OR choose footing types from a list

  • 06

    Per-type mode

    reinforce one representative footing per type, or apply to all instances simultaneously

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Isolated Footing Rebar

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Isolated Footing Rebar
Set up mesh reinforcementManual Revit workflowLay out the upper and lower meshes and adjust the spacing for each footing.With Isolated Footing RebarConfigure mesh layers, bar diameters, and spacing in one setup.
Place side bars and constrain coverManual Revit workflowPlace bars around the perimeter and adjust their cover constraints individually.With Isolated Footing RebarGenerate the side bars and apply the configured cover constraints.
Repeat across matching footingsManual Revit workflowCopy or recreate the detail and check each footing.With Isolated Footing RebarSelect a footing type and apply to one or all matching instances.
Illustrative time comparison

An isolated footing with top mesh, bottom mesh, and side bars

Starts from modeled footings with bar types and cover requirements defined. Both workflows include a visual check. These are planning estimates. Actual times depend on the model and setup.

One footing

Manual in Revit

15–25 min

Place both meshes and the side bars, then check cover.

Isolated Footing Rebar

1–2 min

Set bar sizes, spacing, and cover. Generate and review the footing.

13–24 min estimated savings

Ten matching footings

Manual in Revit

45–70 min

Reuse or place reinforcement and verify it on the ten footings.

Isolated Footing Rebar

3–5 min

Set the footing type once, apply to all ten, and spot-check the results.

40–67 min estimated savings
